name: sync-tab-groups
description: Synchronizes Firefox tab groups and their content across devices

scripts.build:extension: rm -rf builds && bun web-ext:build && bun source:archive
scripts.web-ext:run: bun run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist
scripts.web-ext:build: bun run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir builds --overwrite-dest
scripts.web-ext:sign:command: bun run build && bun run source:archive && web-ext sign --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir builds --channel listed --approval-timeout 0 --upload-source-code builds/source.zip --api-key="$WEB_EXT_API_KEY" --api-secret="$WEB_EXT_API_SECRET"
scripts.web-ext:sign:dev:command: bun run build && web-ext sign --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir builds --channel unlisted --approval-timeout 0 --api-key="$WEB_EXT_API_KEY" --api-secret="$WEB_EXT_API_SECRET"
